baseline_selection.selection_reason: The only selected baseline is an existing positive 2018-2021 executable candidate with recoverable per-security admissions after the 14:25 score cutoff. Industry Diffusion is excluded because its OS contract prohibits another modifier/rescue.
baseline_selection.execution: unchanged next-session-open engine; no same-day fill; existing 10 bp per side costs, limits, suspensions, T+1, and corporate-action handling

model.same_date_full_eligible_universe_rank: Deterministic ascending score rank by (score, symbol), split into five equal-frequency buckets; Q1 is the bottom 20% risk bucket and Q5 is the top 20% safe bucket.

screen.outcomes: Existing baseline completed native position cycles only; no counterfactual labels and no new model scoring.
screen.persistence: At least two calendar years show Q1 worse than Q2-Q5 on either mean completed return or severe-loss rate.
screen.concentration: Q1 adverse result must not have more than 50% of Q1 cycles from one signal date or more than 30% from one security.
screen.replay_authorization: Q1 must be worse than Q2-Q5 on at least one predeclared dimension, meet persistence and concentration checks, and the Q1-excluded cycles must not have a better mean completed return than Q2-Q5.

translation.rule: For an otherwise RS-admitted new CHINEXT V1 candidate, reject the new admission if its same-date frozen moderately_richer Tail-to-Open score is in full-eligible-universe Q1.
translation.unknown_score_policy: NO_SCORE_NO_NEW_VETO: a candidate without a frozen OOF score is passed unchanged and recorded; no score is imputed and no substitute model is used.
translation.replacement: OFF; all existing ranking, exits, sizing, costs, market gate, limits, suspensions, T+1 and corporate-action semantics remain unchanged.
translation.expected_candidate_retention: approximately 80% by construction among scored candidates; realized retention is diagnostic only
